tasks.tactical_info: Helldivers are advised to take these factoids into consideration when placing some of the trickier defensive Stratagems If using Mortar Sentries (both High Explosive and EMS ), it is recommended to place these closer to the Shuttle Bay entrance to possibly allow more pre-emptive clearing around the edges of the emergency evacuation port area. Reward: 500 Experience & 100 Requisition Slips
tasks.tactical_info: General Information [ edit | edit source ] The area is divided into 2 sections. The outer wall has 2 doors, 1 for each direction the enemies can come from, and 1 inner wall with 1 door. These doors may be closed to slow down enemies or opened to retrieve Equipment from outside and let Helldivers back in. There are multiple E/MG-101 HMG Emplacements already stationed, though they will have less than half of their total ammo. 2 behind the outside wall and 2 behind the inside wall. Supplies can be found around the area. Certain Support Weapons can be found in specific spots. The overall mission area is small, making large-scale strategems such as the Orbital 380mm HE Barrage kill teammates more often than not. When building a loadout, it is recommended to look at teammates' loadouts and select stratagems that will work well with theirs. For example, if the A/ARC-3 Tesla Tower has been selected by one Helldiver, it is not recommended to bring an overtly destructive strategem such as the Eagle 500kg Bomb . Stratagems with short cooldowns such as the EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank , MD-6 Anti-Personnel Minefield , or MLS-4X Commando find more value in this mission, due to the relatively short mission time. On a similar note, the Orbital Laser Strategem can be used far more liberally in this mission for the same reason. Closing the gate nearest the Generators can prevent any stealthy enemies from sneaking by the defensive line. When the Generators are actively being damaged, an alarm will sound. Automaton Information [ edit | edit source ] Helldivers should bring Sentries , Emplacements , and anti-tank support weapons to deal with Tanks and Factory Strider cannon turrets in addition to Difficulty appropriate Stratagems . Hard for example will have multiple Hulks . An E/AT-12 Anti-Tank Emplacement can easily down most of the Dropships , resulting in smaller enemy waves that can be mopped up by a Mortar or Autocannon sentry. Alternatively, two Helldivers performing an Assisted Reload with a GR-8 Recoilless Rifle and a steady supply of Resupplies can work similarly. On Suicide Mission and above, Factory Striders which are being dropped into the battlefield should be prioritized, as destroying the Dropship before they can drop the Factory Strider on the ground will instantly kill it. Downed Dropships can crush the Defense Gates very easily. Gunships will never spawn, unless the Gunship Patrols Operation Modifier is active. Terminid Information [ edit | edit source ] If a Charger rams into any gate, it will instantly collapse. Utilizing fire weaponry, such as the Eagle Napalm Airstrike or MD-I4 Incendiary Mines can shut down bug breaches before they even become a problem. Stalkers will never spawn in this mission, unless the Predator Strain is active on the planet. Likewise, Shriekers will never spawn, unless the Roving Shriekers Operation Modifier is active. Standing too close to the edge of the battlements can cause Hunters to fly up and deal damage, even if the gates are closed. Illuminate Information [ edit | edit source ] Leviathans will never target the generators directly, but can still destroy them through collateral damage. Harvesters pose the highest threat of any enemy barring the Stingray due to their extremely powerful long-range laser beams that can instantly destroy generators and kill Helldivers. Therefore, their demise must be met upon arrival. The E/MG-101 HMG Emplacement excels on Illuminate missions, due to its ability to tear through every enemy's armor (excluding the Leviathan). It is especially useful for taking down Stingrays. Elevated Overseers will oftentimes fly over the battlements, ignoring the gates completely. As such, they are considered high-priority targets. The RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher is extremely beneficial on Illuminate missions as the wide AoE cluster explosions can single-handedly clear hordes of Voteless , Overseers , and Fleshmobs with a single rocket. It is recommended to bring the RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher over the Eagle Cluster Bomb as it is not limited by cooldown, only supplies.

tasks.tactical_info: The tops of the towers are often wider than their base, creating a significant overhang. Helldivers should take care when calling in a NUX-223 Hellbomb to ensure the hellpod does not get stuck on the tower when called in. While possessing significantly more health than a regular Shrieker Nest , like all Terminid structures they have almost no armour and can be destroyed via any source of sustained damage from range. They require a demo force of 50 to destroy outright. The Patriot and Emancipator Exo-suits are ideal for this, although doing so will deplete their ammo reserves. The TD-220 Bastion MK XVI can destroy a single tower with either 4 shots, or 3 shots with the main gun and ~66 shots from the coaxial HMG. The M-1000 Maxigun has excellent sustained-fire capability against the Terminid structures, and is perhaps the best support weapon to bring down a tower quickly, ammo notwithstanding. When using the allocated NUX-223 Hellbomb to destroy the tower, be wary of any nearby Civilians and SEAF Troopers , as their lack of situational awareness means they do not have the sense to avoid its massive blast.

tasks.tactical_info: Bug holes at the drilling locations can be easily closed by driving into them. When beginning the mining process, be careful not to be in the way of the arm of the GATER , as it will launch the player when rotating. The Ground All-Terrain Extraction Rig will self-destruct in a huge explosion after completing its task (akin to a Hellbomb ). The Ground All-Terrain Extraction Rig can be destroyed, it can take a lot of damage, but it's susceptible to Hellpods crashing into it, as well as Bile Titans stepping on it, or a Hive Lord emerging from under it. It is highly advised to deal with the Hive Lord before commencing operation of the GATER, as the Hive Lord can fling it out of the map by surfacing under it, immediately failing the mission. Two Helldivers can man the vehicle at the same time, one driver and a gunner. When the driver exits the vehicle, he will stand on top of it and can stay there, while someone else gets into the driver seat and moves it around. (This way the full squad can get onto and into the vehicle.) The mounted Autocannon is similar to the one on the EXO-49 Emancipator Exosuit and has limited ammunition, but doesn't need a manual reload.

tasks.tactical_info: Closing up bug holes will lessen the steady flow of enemies present in the mission. Taking time to close them can be considered if the squad has the extra time to spare. It’s highly recommended to destroy the multiple Spore Spewers found across the map to increase physical visibility. In rare instances, Terminids appear close or directly beneath the Tectonic Drill. Placing an FX-12 Shield Generator Relay before deploying the Tectonic Drill near it will prevent this. However, Bile Titans can pose a threat since it will now attempt to spew Bile on the Energy Shield Relay, which would be close to the Tectonic Drill. If your squad has spare Dark Fluid Vessel , have them dropped and available near the small “islands” leading up to the Extraction Zone to help navigate towards Extraction quicker. Using an EXO-45 Patriot Exosuit or EXO-49 Emancipator Exosuit can help with closing bug holes and dealing with waves of light armored bugs that appear more often in this mission type. Incidentally, being inside the mech when the Tremors appear after finishing the last Tectonic Drill objective will give a nice head-start towards Extraction as you won’t be slowed down. After the objective is completed, massive amounts of Shriekers will start to attack Helldivers after a brief Tremor and will continue to spawn, infinitely. One Strategy that can help when extracting is spending extra time placing several Supply Drops near the Extraction Zone before finishing the last drill. These boxes can help provide precious Stims and Grenades to help protect the squad from the massive amounts of Shriekers. Smoke Stratagems and the G-3 Smoke are excellent when dealing with the massive Shrieker wave that appears near the Extraction Zone. A continuous well-timed screen of smoke can help lessen the amount of attacks the squad receives from the Shriekers, which can be done with G-3 Smoke grenades if the Extraction zone was prepared with Resupplies . Staying Prone also helps dodge Shrieker attacks while other members of the squad are doing the Terminal.

tasks.tactical_info: The Eggs are fragile, numerous, and found in clusters. Helldivers are advised to bring Weapons and Stratagems that deal explosive damage, such as the CB-9 Exploding Crossbow , R-36 Eruptor , GL-21 Grenade Launcher , AC-8 Autocannon or the Eagle Airstrike . A single B-100 Portable Hellbomb or Eagle 500kg Bomb can destroy all the eggs in the nest. Since the Eggs can't take much damage before being destroyed, the FLAM-40 Flamethrower is an efficient choice. While Helldivers are able to destroy eggs with bare-handed melee damage, the bursting eggs create a shockwave sending a Helldiver into fatal impact-damage. Fortunately even short-range melee-weapons such as CQC-5 Combat Hatchet and CQC-30 Stun Baton have long enough reach to dispose eggs without the risk of being expulsed.

tasks.tactical_info: As the Bio-Processors are completely unarmored, they are vulnerable to all Helldiver weaponry , including basic small arms fire. Confrontation with the Automaton Outpost can be easily avoided if a Helldiver is able to throw a high-damaging Stratagem near the Bio-Processors, such as an Eagle 500kg Bomb . Similarly to other Optional Objectives that require Helldivers to destroy a structure, a Hellbomb stratagem is provided to Helldivers when in close proximity to the Bio-Processors. While this method allows Helldivers to destroy the Bio-Processors without using any of their own munitions or Stratagems, it takes substantially longer to call in and arm the Hellbomb than if a Helldiver were to use other means of destruction. A Hellpod has enough Demolition Force to destroy a Bio-Processors, which is easy to achieve by throwing a Stratagem Ball (of something that comes in a Hellpod) in the gap between the two parts of a Bio-Processors, such as the provided Hellbomb Stratagem. A single well-placed Flak mode rocket from the RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher can destroy 2 bio-processors as well as a couple enemies. Bio-Processors can also be destroyed with a single shot from the GP-20 Ultimatum or a TED-63 Dynamite throwable.

tasks.name: Commando: Acquire Evidence
steps: Helldivers must secure the Tactical Video Camera for use. It will be marked on Helldiver's maps and placed inside an already dropped Hellpod .
tasks.tactical_info: The Tactical Video Camera occupies a Helldiver's Support Weapon slot. It is recommended to designate one squad member to not bring a Support Weapon in their loadout, instead carrying the camera. To use the camera, Helldivers must first equip it by pressing the Support Weapon key, then hold down the aim and fire keys. The camera will have a short charge-up, then start recording. This shown by a visible red light and an audible tape rolling sound. To properly record the incriminating evidence, Helldivers must have a clear line of sight to the target. To complete the mission, Helldivers are required to extract with the camera. Extracting without the camera will result in mission failure. Once picked up, the camera will be constantly marked on all Helldiver's maps.

tasks.name: Commando: Extract Intel
steps:
Helldivers must search one or more Automaton Outpost in search for a keycard.
• The keycards bear a resemblance to the Launch Codes found in Launch ICBM .
tasks.tactical_info: The intel package will require Helldivers to constantly hold it in one hand, restricting weapon use to one-handed weapons only. To complete the mission, Helldivers are required to extract with the intel package. Extracting without the black box will result in mission failure. Once picked up, the intel package will be constantly marked on all Helldiver's maps. Note that preemptively destroying the antenna will destroy the entire structure, rendering the intel package unable to be picked up, resulting in mission failure.

tasks.name: Commando: Secure Black Box
steps: Find the downed SEAF recon aircraft
Collect the BLACK BOX
Extract with Black Box
tasks.tactical_info: The black box will require Helldivers to constantly hold it in one hand, restricting weapon use to one-handed weapons only. To complete the mission, Helldivers are required to extract with the black box. Extracting without the black box will result in mission failure. Once picked up, the black box will be constantly marked on all Helldiver's maps. The Collect Black Box objective is the same as the secondary objective in the Retrieve Recon Craft Intel mission.

tasks.name: Confiscate Assets
steps: Call down the Cargo Container stratagem.
Load Fusion Batteries into Cargo Container. (the number required is equal to the current difficulty level plus 1)
A Pelican ship will take away the Cargo Container when it's full.
tasks.tactical_info: Fusion batteries are extremely dangerous and fragile. They will explode if damaged. Helldivers need to be extremely careful when handling them. Press the left mouse button / right trigger to throw the platinum bar forward a short distance, making transportation more convenient.

tasks.name: Destroy Command Bunkers
steps: Call down, arm and defend a Hellbomb until it detonates and destroys the bunker.
tasks.tactical_info: The bunker is armed with fusion turrets & casemates protected by Automaton units, including small pockets further away from the main structure. The fusion turrets & casemates can target Helldivers from long-range unprovoked, so it is advised to be aware of the turrets at all times. Since they can prove to be a nuisance it is advised to use Heavy armor penetrating support weapons such as the AC-8 Autocannon or PLAS-45 Epoch to destroy them from range. They can also be completely disabled by completing the Compromise Automaton Defenses optional objective. The main structure of the bunker is encased in Anti-Tank II armor so only Anti-Tank weapons with Anti-Tank II armor penetration such as the EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank and GR-8 Recoilless Rifle can damage it. Be sure to aim at the actual bunker itself and not the walls. The EAT-411 Leveller , FAF-14 Spear , MS-11 Solo Silo , and TD-220 Bastion MK XVI main gun can destroy the bunker in 1 shot. The EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank, LAS-99 Quasar Cannon , GP-20 Ultimatum , and GR-8 Recoilless Rifle can destroy the bunker in 2 shots. The B/MD C4 Pack and G-123 Thermite need only 2 charges to destroy. The E/AT-12 Anti-Tank Emplacement and EXO-51 Lumberer Exosuit cannon can destroy the bunker in 3-4 shots, depending on range. The EXO-45 Patriot Exosuit 's rockets and the MLS-4X Commando can destroy the bunker in 4 shots.

tasks.name: Destroy Transmission Network
steps: Destroy Antenna Transmitters
tasks.tactical_info: Transmitters plates can be individually destroyed with small arms fire. Explosive weapons such as the CB-9 Exploding Crossbow , R-36 Eruptor or AC-8 Autocannon are most effective for destroying multiple transmitters in a single shot. Optionally the whole tower itself can be destroyed with explosive demolition force, such as the LAS-99 Quasar Cannon . This will also destroy the transmitters itself.

tasks.name: Eliminate Automaton Factory Strider
steps: [ edit | edit source ] Eliminate Factory Strider [ edit | edit source ] “ Orbital infrared scans have detected a Factory Strider in this area. — Objective Overview
tasks.tactical_info: Effective methods of dispatching Factory Striders can be found on their page .

tasks.name: Eliminate Automaton Hulks
steps:
Find Automaton Hulk
• The Hulk will need to be located within the Mission Objective radius. Once Helldivers locate Hulk, the Mission Objective marker will move directly onto it.
• The Hulk will always be the Obliterator variant, equipped with dual rocket launchers.

Eliminate Hulk
• Hellbombs can be called down by Helldivers once the Hulk has been located. Alternatively, Helldivers can use anti-armor weapons such as the GR-8 Recoilless Rifle or stratagems such as the Orbital Precision Strike .
tasks.tactical_info: Effective methods of dispatching Hulks can be found on their page .

tasks.name: Eradicate Automaton Forces
steps: Deploy down the mission area
Eliminate any/all enemy forces entering and/or inside the mission area
tasks.tactical_info: Eradication Missions are set up similarly to Tower Defenses , where Helldivers must "hold" the mission area and eliminate the incoming enemies. Due to the nature of this mission, Helldivers should equip armor, stratagems , and weapons that are effective at eliminating hordes of enemies. Using the RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher is highly recommended due to its massive area clearing capabilities, reloadable nature and can be used when other area clearing stratagems are not available. The best way to use it is to post up on an elevated ridge and shoot down at the hordes of bots and be sure to use the proper modes to avoid a premature detonation which will likely occur in operator and/or teammate death. Equipping Heavy Armor will increase the wearer's survivability, as the small mission area and high volume of enemies results in little room to maneuver and dodge enemy attacks. Since Automatons will be deployed from Dropships , equipping Support Weapons that can eliminate them (either destroying the engines, or the vehicle itself) is highly recommended. However, destroying Dropships will not count towards the kill count; it is only to relieve pressure and reduce the enemies inbound. If the Dropship has deployed its troops, though, its fall and explosion may cause its payload to be destroyed. Deploying Sentries are also beneficial during this mission since it can aid in eliminating enemies, as well as supporting Helldivers in their task. Special care should be taken in their placement to maximize their coverage, and prevent friendly fire. (either to fellow Helldivers, the sentry themselves, or nearby sentries in the line of fire)

tasks.name: Halt Cyborg Production
steps:
Adjust all the valves to maximize hydrogen flow
• There are 2 to 3 valves in each mission area
• Interact with each valve and rotate it until the pressure gauge needle hits the red zone
• Hydrogen pipes, when overloaded, will become hazards that set Helldivers on Fire
tasks.tactical_info: The Cooling Tower requires a demolition force of 50 to destroy, which means it can be destroyed through means other than a NUX-223 Hellbomb : A B-100 Portable Hellbomb . A Eagle 500kg Bomb . Orbital 120mm , Orbital 380mm , Orbital Precision Strike , Orbital Walking Barrage , Orbital Gas Strike , Orbital EMS Strike , or the Orbital Smoke Strike The last three requires a direct hit. The Cyborg Production tower produces an immensely large explosion 30 seconds after the final step to initiate destruction. It is recommended to begin running away as soon as the demolition process begins to survive the shockwave. Make sure the area is clear before entering the Cyborg Production Facility's doors to overload the hydrogen; there is only one way out, and it is easy to be surrounded.

tasks.name: Neutralize Ground-to-Orbit Defenses
steps:
Call down and defend a Hellbomb until it explodes to destroy the orbital cannon.
• Only Hellbombs , B-100 Portable Hellbombs and SEAF Artillery : Mini-Nuke shells can destroy the orbital cannons.
tasks.tactical_info: One configuration of the Orbital Cannon is defended by three ground-level Cannon Turrets . Several Automaton Fabricators also surround each Orbital Cannon. The outpost is moderately defended relative to the difficulty level with a mix of Troopers , Devastators , Hulks , and Scout Striders . In addition, all Orbital Cannons are surrounded with Automaton MG Emplacements . Helldivers should be advised of the burning pit below the bridge in one configuration of the Orbital Cannon, as it is an instant death to fall into it.

tasks.name: Rapid Acquisition
steps:
Seize High-Grade Platinum
• Call down the Cargo Container stratagem.
• Load Platinum Bars into Cargo Container. (the number required is equal to 3 times the current difficulty level)
A Pelican ship will take away the Cargo Container when either the time runs out or it is full allowing Pelican 1 to land for extraction.
Reward: 500 Requisition Slips and 100 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: Large amounts of Automatons spawn on this mission, and the short time limit means Helldivers must balance their forces between holding back the horde and acquiring platinum bars. It is strongly recommended that Helldivers do not designate too many forces towards either carrying bars or covering fire, as neglecting either aspect of this mission easily leads to failure. Press the left mouse button / right trigger to throw the platinum bar forward a short distance, making transportation more convenient. It is recommended to bring crowd control stratagems like MD-8 Gas Mines and EMS Mortar Sentry to disorient enemies and cover the approach of platinum-carrying Helldivers. Eagle Smoke Strike also provides great soft cover for platinum-carrying Helldivers. Orbital Smoke Strike also works but covers less area and cannot be used as quickly.

tasks.name: Sabotage Air Base
steps:
Destroy Air Base Control Tower [ edit | edit source ]
Standard Automaton Megafactory “ All Dropship communication is routed through this Control Tower. Destroying it will disable any long range dropship deployments. — Objective Overview “ This Control Tower is the nexus of enemy aerial operations in the region. — Megafactory objective Overview, Cyberstan mission Locate and unlock system access port Helldivers must find and interact with a SSSD container found inside the base Use Stratagem: SSSD Delivery Helldivers must call down the SSSD by inputting: Collect the SSSD Hard Drive Insert SSSD into receptacle The receptacle can either be found next to the terminal present in the air base, or next to the Air Base Control Tower itself. Hack into the terminal to sabotage Control Tower Helldivers must find and interact with the terminal found inside the base Bypass terminal security Helldivers are presented with a puzzle, requiring them to match Automaton letters into the correct order, shown by the key on the right side of the terminal. Use terminal to sabotage Control Tower Helldivers are required to activate three different switches, similar to a SEAF SAM Site Use terminal to complete sabotage Helldivers are required to press a single switch, doing so will start a 10 second countdown after which the Air Base Control Tower will explode and the objective will be completed. The explosion is similar to that of a NUX-223 Hellbomb , so Helldivers are advised to stay away from the Air Base Control Tower during the countdown sequence.

Destroy Dropships [ edit | edit source ]
Standard Automaton Megafactory “ An Automaton Air Base is located in this region. Dropships are undergoing maintenance at this facility, leaving them vulnerable. — Objective Overview “ Automaton Dropships are docked at this location. — Megafactory objective Overview, Cyberstan mission Destroy Automaton Dropships Helldivers are required to use any means necessary to destroy all Dropships present.
tasks.tactical_info: The Dropships in the "Destroy Dropships" objective are not the same as their flying counterparts as they have significantly less health at 1,000 vs 3,500, and the thrusters are not separate parts of the fuselage. Eagle stratagems such as the Eagle 500kg Bomb , Eagle Airstrike , and Eagle Strafing Run can destroy multiple dropships. Any Weapon/Stratagem with Anti-Tank I armor penetration, preferably with high durable damage such as the PLAS-45 Epoch or LAS-99 Quasar Cannon , can destroy the grounded Dropships. 1 shot with any Anti-Tank. 1 shot from the GP-20 Ultimatum or 2 from the P-33 Missile Pistol 1 G-123 Thermite or G-48 Giga Grenade , or 2 TM-1 Lure Mine 2 fully-charged shots with the PLAS-45 Epoch . 3-4 99% charged shots with the RS-422 Railgun . Conventional attacks cannot destroy the Air Base Control Tower. You must call down the objective equipment, insert it, and engage the terminal to self-destruct the tower.

tasks.name: Sabotage Orgo-Plasma Synthesis
steps:
Destroy the bio-processors (up to 5 per objective)
• The Helldivers must destroy the specified number of bio-processors in order to complete the objective.
tasks.tactical_info: Bio-Processors are completely unarmored, so they are vulnerable to all Helldiver weaponry , including basic small arms fire. Can be destroyed in one shot from the GP-20 Ultimatum or a single TED-63 Dynamite . Direct Confrontation with the Outpost can be easily avoided if a Helldiver is able to throw a high-damaging Stratagem near the Bio-Processors, such as an Eagle 500kg Bomb . Similar to other Optional Objectives that require Helldivers to destroy a structure, a Hellbomb stratagem is provided to Helldivers when in close proximity to the Bio-Processors. While this method allows Helldivers to destroy the Bio-Processors without using any of their own munitions or Stratagems, it takes substantially longer to call in and arm it than if they used their own equipment. A Hellpod has enough Demolition Force to destroy a Bio-Processor, which can be achieved by throwing a Stratagem Ball in the gap between the two parts of a Bio-Processors.

This explosion may set off other stockpiles if they are close enough together Destruction is counted when the ammunition is ignited, not when it explodes The Fuel Reserves can only be destroyed with demolition force 60 such as by a Hellbomb , B-100 Portable Hellbomb or SEAF Artillery : Mini-Nuke. In the mission to liberate Cyberstan, for the parallel pattern of fuel depots, you can destroy them in one go by precisely deploying a Hellbomb between the two fuel depot containers; for the diagonal pattern, place it at the closest corner to achieve a one-time destruction (orbital smoke grenades can cover your action to ensure precise placement).

tasks.name: Seize Industrial Complex
steps:
Locate and unlock system access port
• Helldivers must find and interact with a SSSD container found inside the Refinery

tasks.name: Blitz: Destroy Illuminate Warp Gateways
tasks.name_zh: 闪电战：摧毁光能族跃迁门
steps:
Find and destroy any active Warp Gateways
• A random number of Illuminate Warp Gateways must be destroyed.
Reward: Before multipliers, between 375 and 1250 Requisition Slips , and between 75 and 250 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: Because the mission's premise is about locating and destroying Warp Gateways, it is recommended to bring equipment that is capable of destroying them: The G-123 Thermite is a good throwable for destroying the Warp Gateways because Helldivers do not have to wait for the center aperture to open. Similar performance can be achieved by Stratagems such as Eagle Strafing Run and Orbital Gatling Barrage . Anti-Tank Support Weapons such as the GR-8 Recoilless Rifle , FAF-14 Spear , and LAS-99 Quasar Cannon can destroy the Warp Gateways from a long distance, providing safety for the Helldivers.

tasks.name: Blitz: Destroy Illuminate Warp Ships
tasks.name_zh: 闪电战：摧毁光能族跃迁舰
steps:
Find and destroy any active Warp Ships
• A random number of Illuminate Warp Ships must be destroyed.
Reward: Before multipliers, between 375 and 1250 Requisition Slips , and between 75 and 250 Experience
tasks.tactical_info: Warp Ships have a protective shield around them, you can break the shield for a small window of time to throw an explosive into the open door Warp Ships may have Lightning Spires stationed around them; to destroy these towers it is recommended to bring an Explosive Weapon such as the GP-31 Grenade Pistol or CB-9 Exploding Crossbow The Lightning Spires and the conduit-torch towers are considered as structures which require demolition force for the destruction. This means weapons like PLAS-1 Scorcher won't be able to destroy these towers. All explosive weapons can one-shot grounded warp ships from the door if the shield has been taken down. An Orbital Gas Strike , Orbital Laser , Orbital Precision Strike , Orbital Railcannon Strike , Eagle 500kg Bomb , a hit or explosion from a 120mm / 380mm / Walking Barrage shot or SEAF Artillery will destroy the Warp Ship even if its shields are activated.

tasks.name: Blitz: Suppress Toxic Pollination
steps: Eradicate Void Blossoms in the area (the required number depends on objective layout)
tasks.tactical_info: This article is a stub . You can help by expanding it . The Void Blossom's petals have Medium armor, whereas the corona has Very Light armor. Shooting the corona will instantly destroy the flower. The Void Blossoms are fragile and found in clusters, Helldivers are advised to bring Weapons and Stratagems that deal explosive damage, such as the CB-9 Exploding Crossbow , GL-21 Grenade Launcher , or the Eagle Airstrike . Destroying the flower releases a powder around it which reverses certain Helldiver controls. The powder lasts for a few seconds and Helldivers afflicted by it will have their screen distorted. The area of reverse effect is 5 Meters and lasts for 12 seconds. If a Helldiver destroyed the flower outside of the reverse effect's range or walked into the powder, they will be affected only with a distortion effect, slowed movement and the inability to sprint. Although the screen distortion effect disappears once Helldivers leave the area of effect, control reversal will persist for a few seconds. The inputs for moving left and right will be reversed, as will the inputs for moving the camera left or right, and the Helldiver will be unable to sprint. Thus diving rapidly to exit the area of effect is advised.

steps: [ edit | edit source ]
